claims.gist: Malicious packages are published daily via typosquatting, dependency confusion and takeovers
Generate SBOMs that include transitive dependencies for visibility
Route installs through an internal proxy and block public registries from builds
Wait three to seven days before pulling new package versions into builds
Many malicious versions are detected and removed within hours or days
Commit lockfiles and fail CI when they do not match
Disable install scripts by default and allow them only for reviewed packages
Controls that slow developers down get bypassed

thesis: Reduce open-source malware risk through visibility, source control, waiting periods, pinning, limited install scripts and detection.
